mapper.select: SELECT activity.activity_id, activity.activity_code, activity.product_id, activity.sale_price, activity.total_stock, activity.available_stock, activity.per_user_limit, activity.status, activity.starts_at, activity.ends_at, activity.version, product.product_id AS catalog_product_id, product.price AS catalog_price, product.stock AS catalog_stock, product.status AS catalog_status, product.deleted_at AS catalog_deleted_at FROM flash_sale_activity activity LEFT JOIN catalog_product product ON product.product_id = activity.product_id WHERE activity.activity_id = #{activityId}
